column1: # Greek business-name words (curated 2026-11-10). Greek names are often in capitals in registers,
# written here in title case: Γ. Παπαδόπουλος & ΣΙΑ, Κατασκευαστική Αττικής. Trade words are
# feminine adjectives agreeing with "εταιρεία". Words carry the ELOT 743 Latin form after "=", used
# for domains. A section key serves every division of the section that has no row of its own.
